news.headline: Waymo Pauses Ride-Hailing Services in San Francisco Bay Area Due to Severe Weather
news.summary: Alphabet's Waymo unit is temporarily suspending its ride-hailing operations across the San Francisco Bay Area in response to severe weather conditions.

news.headline: Waymo Issues Safety Recall Following California Freeway Ban
news.summary: Alphabet's autonomous driving subsidiary, Waymo, has issued a double safety recall for its vehicles following recent regulatory actions in California.

news.headline: NVIDIA Former CEO Jensen Huang Agrees to Senate Testimony
news.summary: Former NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang has reportedly agreed to testify in public before the U.S. Senate regarding recent controversies.

news.headline: Trump Administration Pushes for Reinstatement of Jensen Huang as NVIDIA CEO
news.summary: The Trump administration has publicly advocated for the rehiring of former CEO Jensen Huang to lead NVIDIA following his recent resignation.

news.headline: NVIDIA Launches Alpamayo 2 Edge Vision-Language-Action Model
news.summary: NVIDIA has officially released Alpamayo 2 Edge, a 2-billion-parameter reasoning model designed for real-time autonomous driving on its DRIVE AGX Thor platform.

news.headline: Tesla Announces December Rollout for FSD V15
news.summary: Tesla has confirmed plans to release the next version of its Full Self-Driving (FSD) software, V15, in December 2026.

news.headline: JPMorgan Downgrades Nemetschek to Underweight
news.summary: Analyst Joseph George of JPMorgan downgraded Nemetschek SE to 'Underweight' and removed the stock from the bank's 'Analyst Focus List' due to concerns over the company's complex investment narrative.

news.headline: DXL Adopts Meta's Muse AI Agent for Customer Engagement
news.summary: Retailer DXL has integrated Meta's Muse AI agent, in collaboration with commercetools, to enhance its customer reach and engagement strategies.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley and Loop Capital Adjust Price Targets for Meta Platforms
news.summary: Financial analysts at Morgan Stanley and Loop Capital have revised their price targets for Meta Platforms, Inc. following recent market developments.

news.headline: Taiwan Authorities Investigate Fake Threads Accounts for Alleged Election Interference
news.summary: Taiwanese officials have flagged a network of fake accounts on Meta's Threads platform, alleging they were used to influence local election outcomes.

news.headline: Microsoft UAE and Space42 Release Report on Geospatial Agentic AI
news.summary: Microsoft UAE and Space42 have published a joint report exploring the potential of Geospatial Agentic AI to assist governments in operationalizing intelligence for public services.

news.headline: Microsoft and Audi Launch Mobile Work Agent for In-Vehicle Productivity
news.summary: Microsoft, in collaboration with Cerence AI and Audi, has introduced the 'Mobile Work Agent' to integrate Microsoft 365 productivity tools into Audi vehicles.

news.headline: Microsoft to Retire Microsoft To Do App in 2027
news.summary: Microsoft has announced that it will discontinue the Microsoft To Do application on June 30, 2027, and is encouraging users to transition to Microsoft Planner.
